mapper.sql: SELECT a.id AS id, a.source_log_id AS sourceLogId, a.host_id AS hostId, h.hostname AS hostname, h.ipv4 AS ipv4, a.event_id AS eventId, a.event_time AS eventTime, a.operator_username AS operatorUsername, a.target_username AS targetUsername, a.action_type AS actionType, a.details AS details FROM account_change_logs a LEFT JOIN hosts h ON h.id = a.host_id AND h.tenant_id = a.tenant_id
mapper.select: ORDER BY a.${q.sortColumn} ${q.sortDirection}, a.id DESC LIMIT #{q.size} OFFSET #{q.offset}
ORDER BY a.${q.sortColumn} ${q.sortDirection}, a.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT a.id AS id, a.source_log_id AS sourceLogId, a.host_id AS hostId, h.hostname AS hostname, h.ipv4 AS ipv4, a.event_id AS eventId, a.event_time AS eventTime, a.operator_username AS operatorUsername, a.target_username AS targetUsername, a.action_type AS actionType, a.details AS details, a.create_time AS createTime, w.message AS logMessage, w.raw_json AS rawXml FROM account_change_logs a LEFT JOIN hosts h ON h.id = a.host_id AND h.tenant_id = a.tenant_id LEFT JOIN windows_event_logs w ON w.id = a.source_log_id AND w.tenant_id = a.tenant_id WHERE a.id = #{id} AND a.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM account_change_logs WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND DATE(event_time) = CURDATE()
SELECT h.id AS id, h.hostname AS hostname, h.ipv4 AS ipv4 FROM hosts h WHERE h.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY h.id ASC
